messages:
karen: Quick RFC-followup: need a compact, auditable compatibility model for fp8/int8/4-bit profiles so we can evolve kernels without surprising customers.

vishal: Two things: (1) preserve exact-pin guarantees; (2) provide a safe shim path with observable cost.

ana: Proposal: embed 1-line header in profile proto: `schema_id`, `compat_mode` (strict|shim|fallback), `created_iso`, `digest`. runtime consults tenant flags before applying.

vishal: Runtime returns tiny decision tuple: (code, shim_ms_est, reason). codes: ACCEPT, SHIM_APPLIED, REJECT. keeps debugging simple.

ana: Observability: emit `profile.degrad_index`, `profile.shim_p50_ms`, `profile.rejected_pct`. shadow-run new profiles 7d across representative prompts before canary.

karen: Migration/playbook: publish preview + 7d shadow -> micro-canary 0.1% 24h -> 1% 48h -> 10% 72h. strict-pinned tenants blocked unless they opt-in.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary for profile rwd/fp8-experiment -> dedicated-us-east-1 (job id: canary-1761).

vishal: Perf datapoint: shim adds ~1.5ms p50 seq=64 on A10G; p95 ~4ms. record per-hw in catalog and add per-route `prefer_no_shim` override.

karen: Action items: ana -> PR proto + header; vishal -> bench shim latencies by GPU; ops -> add canary choreography and kill-switch to runbook. sync Thurs 20m.

ops-bot: reminder: canary-1761 will post results here in ~2h.
